data.heading: Where oat opportunities look strongest.
data.summary: The source report indicates that oat product activity is not evenly distributed. Mexico and Brazil are the largest selected markets by combined proxy volume and product-launch activity, while Japan is the largest selected APAC market. The Philippines and South Korea appear more targeted, with useful innovation signals and Canadian product presence.
